title: Typestate pattern prevents invalid state machine transitions at compile time
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Lines: 193-357

The `RouteDiscovery<S>` generic with marker types (Idle, Searching, Replied, Failed) makes illegal transitions unrepresentable at compile time:
- `start()` only available on `RouteDiscovery<Idle>`
- `advance_ring()` and `receive_rrep()` only on `RouteDiscovery<Searching>`
- Terminal states (Replied, Failed) have no transition methods

This is a robust pattern that eliminates an entire class of runtime state machine bugs.
